claim: Revenue increased by 15% last quarter.
passage_support: Revenue increased by 15% last quarter compared to the same period a year earlier.
passage_contradict: Revenue declined by 15% last quarter compared to the same period a year earlier.
passage_neutral: Last quarter's results were discussed in detail during the earnings call.

claim: X joined the company in 2018.
passage_support: X joined the company in 2018 as a senior engineer.
passage_contradict: X left the company in 2018, three years after joining in 2015.
passage_neutral: X has worked in the technology industry for over a decade.

claim: Treatment X caused the improvement.
passage_support: Researchers concluded that Treatment X directly caused the observed improvement in symptoms.
passage_contradict: The study found no evidence that Treatment X caused the improvement; researchers attributed it to natural recovery.
passage_neutral: Treatment X was administered daily for six weeks.

claim: The company's profit margin was 20%.
passage_support: The company reported a profit margin of 20% for the fiscal year.
passage_contradict: The company reported a profit margin of 5% for the fiscal year, far below the 20% figure some analysts expected.
passage_neutral: Profit margin is one of several metrics tracked in the company's annual report.

claim: The city was founded in the 12th century.
passage_support: Historical records place the city's founding in the 12th century.
passage_contradict: Archaeological evidence now dates the city's founding to the 9th century, three hundred years earlier than previously believed.
passage_neutral: The city's original name has changed several times over its history.

claim: The reaction is exothermic.
passage_support: Calorimetry confirmed the reaction releases heat, consistent with an exothermic process.
passage_contradict: Calorimetry showed the reaction absorbs heat, indicating it is endothermic rather than exothermic.
passage_neutral: The reaction was studied at a range of temperatures and pressures.

claim: X is currently the CEO of the company.
passage_support: X currently serves as the company's chief executive officer.
passage_contradict: X stepped down as CEO last year and no longer holds any executive role at the company.
passage_neutral: X previously worked at two other technology companies before joining this one.

claim: The drug is approved for adult use.
passage_support: Regulators approved the drug for use in adult patients.
passage_contradict: Regulators explicitly declined to approve the drug for adult use, citing safety concerns.
passage_neutral: The drug is manufactured at a single facility.

claim: The population of the species is 4.5 million.
passage_support: Current estimates place the species' population at approximately 4.5 million individuals.
passage_contradict: Current estimates place the species' population at approximately 450,000 individuals, an order of magnitude below earlier claims.
passage_neutral: The species' population is monitored using aerial surveys.

claim: The team ranks first in the league.
passage_support: The team currently sits atop the league standings in first place.
passage_contradict: The team currently sits in last place in the league standings, not first.
passage_neutral: The league standings are updated weekly throughout the season.

claim: The two companies remain independent.
passage_support: The two companies have not merged and continue to operate as separate, independent entities.
passage_contradict: The two companies completed a merger last year and now operate as a single combined entity.
passage_neutral: The two companies have collaborated on joint research projects in the past.

claim: The vaccine requires a single dose.
passage_support: The vaccine is administered as a single dose providing full protection.
passage_contradict: The vaccine requires two doses, not one, administered several weeks apart for full protection.
passage_neutral: The vaccine is stored at refrigerated temperatures.

claim: The signal was detected at 400 megahertz.
passage_support: The instrument detected the signal at a frequency of 400 megahertz.
passage_contradict: The instrument detected the signal at a frequency of 40 megahertz, ten times lower than the reported figure.
passage_neutral: The signal was observed over a three-night observation window.

claim: The factory operates around the clock.
passage_support: The factory runs three shifts and operates twenty-four hours a day.
passage_contradict: The factory operates a single eight-hour shift and is closed overnight, not around the clock.
passage_neutral: The factory employs roughly 2,000 workers.

claim: The battle took place before the treaty was signed.
passage_support: The battle occurred several months before the treaty was formally signed.
passage_contradict: The battle actually took place after the treaty was signed, in violation of its terms.
passage_neutral: The treaty was negotiated by representatives from both nations.

claim: Higher doses produced a stronger effect.
passage_support: The study found a clear dose-response relationship: higher doses produced a stronger effect.
passage_contradict: The study found the opposite of a dose-response relationship: higher doses produced a weaker effect than lower doses.
passage_neutral: Doses in the study ranged from 5 to 100 milligrams.

claim: The subsidiary is wholly owned by the parent company.
passage_support: Corporate filings confirm the subsidiary is 100% owned by the parent company.
passage_contradict: Corporate filings show the parent company sold its majority stake, and the subsidiary is no longer wholly owned by it.
passage_neutral: The subsidiary was established over twenty years ago.

claim: The patient's condition improved after surgery.
passage_support: Follow-up examinations showed the patient's condition improved significantly after surgery.
passage_contradict: Follow-up examinations showed the patient's condition worsened after surgery, requiring further intervention.
passage_neutral: The surgery lasted approximately three hours.

claim: The glacier has been retreating for decades.
passage_support: Satellite imagery confirms the glacier has been steadily retreating for the past several decades.
passage_contradict: Satellite imagery shows the glacier has actually advanced over the past several decades, not retreated.
passage_neutral: The glacier is monitored using annual satellite passes.

claim: The two executives resigned on the same day.
passage_support: Both executives submitted their resignations on the same day, effective immediately.
passage_contradict: The two executives resigned nearly a year apart, not on the same day as reported.
passage_neutral: Both executives had served on the company's board for several years.

claim: The correlation between the variables is positive.
passage_support: The analysis found a statistically significant positive correlation between the two variables.
passage_contradict: The analysis found a statistically significant negative correlation between the two variables, the opposite of what was claimed.
passage_neutral: Both variables were measured using standardized instruments.

claim: The match ended in a draw.
passage_support: The match finished level, ending in a 1-1 draw.
passage_contradict: The match did not end in a draw; one team won decisively 3-0.
passage_neutral: The match was played in front of a sold-out stadium.

claim: The country's unemployment rate fell to 4%.
passage_support: The latest figures show the unemployment rate falling to 4%, its lowest level in years.
passage_contradict: The latest figures show the unemployment rate rising to 9%, not falling to 4% as claimed.
passage_neutral: Unemployment figures are released monthly by the national statistics agency.

claim: The clinical trial excluded pregnant participants.
passage_support: The trial's protocol explicitly excluded pregnant participants from enrollment.
passage_contradict: The trial's protocol did not exclude pregnant participants; several were enrolled and monitored separately.
passage_neutral: The trial enrolled participants across twenty research sites.

claim: The mutation is recessive.
passage_support: Genetic analysis confirmed the mutation follows a recessive inheritance pattern.
passage_contradict: Genetic analysis confirmed the mutation follows a dominant, not recessive, inheritance pattern.
passage_neutral: The mutation was first identified in a family with a history of the condition.

claim: The company filed for bankruptcy in 2020.
passage_support: The company formally filed for bankruptcy protection in early 2020.
passage_contradict: The company avoided bankruptcy entirely in 2020 after securing emergency financing at the last moment.
passage_neutral: The company had faced mounting financial pressure for several years before 2020.

claim: The explorer was the first to reach the pole.
passage_support: Historical accounts credit the explorer as the first person to reach the pole.
passage_contradict: Historical records later showed a rival expedition actually reached the pole first, days before the explorer.
passage_neutral: The expedition took over two months to complete.

claim: The sample tested positive for the compound.
passage_support: Laboratory analysis confirmed the sample tested positive for the compound.
passage_contradict: Laboratory analysis confirmed the sample tested negative for the compound, contrary to initial reports.
passage_neutral: The sample was analyzed using standard chromatography techniques.

claim: The board approved the acquisition unanimously.
passage_support: The board voted unanimously to approve the acquisition.
passage_contradict: The board was split on the acquisition, with several members voting against it rather than approving unanimously.
passage_neutral: The board meeting lasted several hours.

claim: The infection rate doubled within a month.
passage_support: Health data show the infection rate doubled within a single month.
passage_contradict: Health data show the infection rate actually halved within that month, not doubled.
passage_neutral: Infection rates are tracked using weekly surveillance reports.
